CheckTitle: EBS volume is not protected by an AWS Backup plan
Description: EBS volumes have not been are assigned to an active AWS Backup plan to safeguard data against accidental deletion, ransomware, or system failure.
Risk: EBS volumes without a backup plan lack automated disaster recovery coverage. Data loss, corruption, or ransomware attacks may lead to irreversible data destruction and extended operational downtime.

Recommendation.Text: Assign EBS volumes to an AWS Backup plan either directly by resource ARN or dynamically using resource tags.
